id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_100.pack|cs_: "...Sorry, but I'm not the man from your story. You must have me mixed up with somebody else.
"Don't give us that nonsense! We know you're the only Kai in Lonalulu!
"If you never meant to marry that poor mermaid, you should never have proposed to her!
"Hey, go easy on the accusations. People here got no love for mermaids. If they think I do, I'll be in trouble.
"The Kai you're looking for is my grandfather, Kainoa. I take it you've heard the tale of the mermaid's curse?
"Every kid in Lonalulu knows it. The famous fisherman whose soul was stolen by a mermaid.
"He got so obsessed with that creature that he abandoned the Kahuna's daughter and was banished to Saikiki Beach.
"Yes, yes, your mother told us all about it! But what does an old fairy tale have to do with anything? Michelle's waiting!
"That's what I'm trying to tell you. It's not a fairy tale! The fisherman from the story was my grandpa!
"It all happened fifty years ago, just like my ma tells it. But the story didn't end there...
"Ten years after Grandpa got chased out, the Kahuna's daughter, Leilani, married another man, and they had a kid.
"After the baby came, people started to forget about Kainoa and the curse. Till one day...
"Another great storm struck, even more violent than the one that sent my grandfather to the bottom of the sea.
"The Kahuna's boat went down, and him and his daughter's new husband went with it.
"The men who survived went to tell Leilani, but she and the baby were nowhere to be found.
"The villagers said it was the mermaid's revenge, that she took all four because she couldn't have Kainoa.
"So they lit torches and marched to Saikiki Beach to confront him.
"When they threw open the door of his hut, they couldn't believe what they saw...
"He'd been alone for ten years...but there he was with a baby in his arms. And the baby was dripping with water...
"They ran off screaming that he must have had a child with the mermaid. No one from the village went to Saikiki again.
"Wait, that baby must have been your mother...which would mean she was half mermaid? Which would make you-
"Don't even say it! My mother is a human being! My grandpa found her abandoned on the beach and raised her!
"He never had a kid with a mermaid! It's a stupid rumour made up by superstitious fishermen!
"If that mermaid really is still out there waiting for Grandpa, there's something I want you to give her.
"Meet me on Saikiki Beach past the cape. Go through the chapel at the back of the village. I'll unlock the door.
